pages.text: $(d)Obsidian Water Walking Boots$() combine the effects of the $(l:irregular_implements:armor/water_walking_boots)Water Walking Boots$(/l) and the $(l:irregular_implements:items/obsidian_skull)Obsidian Skull$(/l).$(br2)Get them by combining the two in an Anvil.
Note that this does not let you walk on Lava! You'll have to use the $(l:irregular_implements:armor/lava_waders)Lava Waders$(/l) for that.
